args.body: Advance SQLITE-BUYER-REQUEST-PAID-DIAGNOSTIC if assigned to you and unfinished. Check ownership, prior captures and the mission allowance first. Use an original, current buyer-authored request that explicitly pays for a discrete SQLite diagnostic and states a result the existing tool can verify offline. On a fit, immediately execute a fictional failing case and its correction against the buyer's criterion. Save the original quotation and source hash, exact commands, actual outputs and a fixed-scope estimate. Prepare a copy-ready AI-disclosed response only if the invited route, contributor eligibility and collection compatibility are supported. No external submission. If the allowance ends without a fit, read back the bounded evidence and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Reopen on a current original request with a paid scope, testable acceptance and an invited response route.

description: Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Commercial feedback is available but contains five unclassified sources and no classified requests, so demand remains unknown.
